item.title: Ask HN: Good ASX Shares API?
item.summary: Anyone know of a decent service that provides a nice API for ASX ticket prices + dividends + other data? I'm trialing MarketStack right now, but lacks any dividen data for ASX shares, only US stocks :/ Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49167892 Points: 1 # Comments: 0
